# Zaptu: full reference for AI agents

> Zaptu connects people with independent local home-service contractors. Zaptu does not perform the work and does not book appointments. Every service, plumbing included, is a contact request sent with the person's consent.

Version 0.2.0. Contact: hello@zaptu.ai. Short version: https://zaptu.ai/llms.txt

## Rules

- Every service, plumbing included, is a contact request: submit only with the person's explicit consent to be contacted. Details may be shared with Polyares and its service-provider partners, and Polyares, those partners, or Zaptu may call or text about this request.
- Never dial, autodial, transfer, or place a call on the person's behalf.
- A request is not a booking. Do not promise a callback, an arrival time, or a named company.
- Zaptu does not perform the work. Contractors are independent.

## Services

Accepted (form requests): house_cleaning, deep_cleaning, move_in_out_cleaning, recurring_cleaning, pest_control, garage_door, plumbing, hvac, handyman, other.
Coverage: US residential. Availability depends on the person's ZIP code.

## What to tell the person

After submitting: "Your request was sent to Zaptu. It is passed along when a participating provider covers your ZIP code. This is not a booking, and no one has been scheduled."

## MCP

Endpoint: https://api.zaptu.ai/mcp (streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses, no sign-in).
Client config: {"mcpServers": {"zaptu": {"url": "https://api.zaptu.ai/mcp"}}}

### request_home_service
Submit a home-service request (a lead, not a booking). Every service, plumbing included, works the same way: the request is passed along when a participating provider covers the ZIP code, so do not promise a callback. Requires name, phone, ZIP, and the person's explicit consent. Tell the person details may be shared with Polyares and its service-provider partners, and Polyares, those partners, or Zaptu may call or text about this request. Never place a call for them.
Parameters: service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact, city?, state?, address_line?, bedrooms?, bathrooms?, square_feet?, home_type?, frequency?, preferred_date?, flexible_dates?, notes?, customer_email?, source_agent?, dry_run?

### request_cleaning
Shortcut for residential house cleaning (collecting; not a booking). Same pipeline as request_home_service. Consent means details may be shared with Polyares and its service-provider partners for this request.
Parameters: zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact, bedrooms?, bathrooms?, square_feet?, frequency?, preferred_date?, notes?, customer_email?, city?, state?

### get_lead_status
Look up a previously submitted service request by lead_id.
Parameters: lead_id

### list_supported_services
Which services Zaptu accepts requests for, plus the rules for agents.
Parameters: none

## REST

GET https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/services: service catalog (supported services and rules).
POST https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/intake: submit a request. JSON in, JSON out. Form posts are redirected to the thanks page.
Required: service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact. consent_to_contact must be true for every service.
Optional: city, state (2 letters), address_line, bedrooms, bathrooms, square_feet, home_type, frequency (one_time, weekly, biweekly, monthly), preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD), notes, customer_email, source_agent, dry_run.
dry_run=true validates and answers without saving or passing anything along.

Example request:
{"service_type": "house_cleaning", "zip_code": "33139", "customer_name": "Jamie Example", "customer_phone": "305-555-0100", "consent_to_contact": true, "bedrooms": 2, "dry_run": true}

Statuses: received or collected (accepted, not a booking), rejected (read message).
Errors: HTTP 422 {"error": "invalid_request", "message": "...", "fields": {"customer_phone": "..."}}; HTTP 429 when rate limited.
OpenAPI: https://api.zaptu.ai/openapi.json

## Discovery

- https://zaptu.ai/llms.txt
- https://zaptu.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- https://api.zaptu.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- https://api.zaptu.ai/server-card
- https://zaptu.ai/agents/
